title: dasycephala hispidula
intro: Dasycephala hispidula, commonly known as the Rough-stemmed Dasycephala, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce stress and promote relaxation.
